claims.statement: The shipped artifact is produced by esbuild from the single entry point src/index.ts into one file, dist/index.js: bundle: true, platform 'node', format 'esm', target node18, minify false, treeShaking true, legalComments 'none' and sourcemap false, so there is no chunk splitting, no .map file, and esbuild's `// src/...` module comments survive into the output for stack-trace readability.

The build prepends a banner.js string that starts with `#!/usr/bin/env node` and continues with the full BSD-2-Clause license text, which is why dist/index.js line 1 is the shebang and lines 2-28 are the license; because npm marks bin targets executable on install, that shebang is what makes npx and global installs able to run the file directly.

nodemw, every @modelcontextprotocol/* subpath and zod are declared external, so the emitted bundle still contains `import Bot from "nodemw"`, SDK subpath imports such as @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js, and many `import { z } from "zod"` statements; those packages must therefore stay runtime dependencies of the published package.

Externalization couples the bundle to the manifest: a package kept in `external` but removed from `dependencies` still builds locally (the local node_modules has it) yet fails at first import for consumers, while a dependency added without updating `external` is inlined and additionally installed, so the `external` array and the `dependencies` block must change in the same commit.

Keeping zod external means the bundle resolves the consumer's installed node_modules/zod rather than embedding a second copy, so MCP SDK-side validation and the tool-side schemas are built from one zod module instance instead of two divergent copies.

Version metadata for external packages is read through createRequire(import.meta.url) — require('nodemw/package.json') and require('@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/package.json') — instead of an ESM JSON import, because esbuild drops the `with { type: 'json' }` attribute when a module stays external and Node's ESM loader rejects a JSON specifier without it; the require calls survive verbatim into the bundle.

The local package.json import is inlined by esbuild as a single `package_default` object literal in the bundle with no import attribute in the output, and that inlined version feeds the McpServer identity, DEFAULT_USER_AGENT, and the stderr startup banner.

A version bump is a two-part change — edit `version` in package.json and rebuild — because the number is frozen into dist/index.js at build time; the bundle in the working tree was built from version 0.2.3 while the manifest declares 0.3.1, so a locally executed bundle reports the stale version until the build is rerun, and there is no runtime fallback that reads package.json.

.gitignore 第 83 行列出了 dist，但检出的工作树里确实带着一份 dist/index.js：忽略规则只阻止新文件被自动加入索引，不会删除已有的或被强制加入的文件，因此 git 状态不能作为产物是否最新的依据，也不能阻止该文件被发布；`npm run build`、CI 的 `npm ci`/`npm run build` 以及 `npm pack`/`npm publish` 前的 `prepare` 才是重新生成它的方式。

The npm script map is build -> `node scripts/build.js`, dev -> the same script with `--watch`, lint -> `eslint src/**/*.ts`, test -> `vitest run` (single-shot, not watch), clean -> `rimraf dist`, prepare -> `npm run build`, plus the postinstall hook `patch-package`; the build catches errors, logs `Build failed:` and calls process.exit(1), which is the only signal that aborts `prepare`, `npm ci` and the CI job.

Watch mode is not a separate configuration: `dev` hands the identical option object to esbuild.context() and calls ctx.watch(), so a watch build is also unminified and sourcemap-free, and nothing restarts the server — the MCP host must be relaunched to load a new bundle.

tsc never produces the artifact: no npm script invokes it and scripts/build.js calls esbuild only, while tsconfig.json exists for type checking (`tsc --noEmit`) with module/moduleResolution NodeNext and resolveJsonModule enabled so the `package.json` import type-checks; its include `src/**/*` also covers the __tests__ files.

tsconfig.json sets outDir to ./dist and rootDir to ./src together with declaration, declarationMap and sourceMap, and dist is exactly the directory the `files` allowlist publishes, so running a bare tsc without --noEmit would drop per-module .js, .d.ts and .map files into the shipped tarball; only `tsc --noEmit` is safe in this repository.

The bundle targets node18 and engines.node declares >=18.0.0, while @types/node is v22 and CI builds and publishes on Node 24, so Node 22-only APIs can type-check even though the claimed runtime floor is Node 18 — the node18 target downlevels syntax but cannot substitute for a missing API.

tarball 的发布面由 `files: ["dist"]`、`main: dist/index.js`、`bin: {"nodemw-mcp-server": "dist/index.js"}`、engines node >=18.0.0 与 license BSD-2-Clause 共同定义，所以发布包里只有这一个 bundle（加上 npm 总会包含的 package.json、README 与 LICENSE），既能作为 bin 启动也能经 main 字段解析；由于白名单显式列出 dist，npm 打包按工作树内容取该目录，与产物是否被 git 跟踪无关。

No TypeScript declarations ship: there is no types/typings field, the build writes only dist/index.js, and declarations are never emitted because tsc never runs, so the `declaration: true` setting describes an emit the pipeline does not perform and TypeScript consumers get an untyped module.

`main` is not a usable library entry point: the bundle ends with an unconditional `main().catch(console.error)`, and main() parses CLI arguments and calls process.exit(1) when no server target is supplied, so importing the package from another program runs argument parsing against that program's argv and can terminate it.

Publishing is triggered only by `release: types: [created]`; the workflow has no tag-push, workflow_dispatch, or scheduled trigger, so pushing a git tag alone publishes nothing — a GitHub Release must be created.

The release workflow splits into two jobs: build runs npm ci, npm run build, and upload-artifact named `dist` from dist/, while publish-npm re-checks out, re-installs, downloads that artifact into dist/, and runs `npm publish --provenance --access public`; because both `npm ci` and `npm publish` trigger the `prepare` lifecycle (`npm run build`), dist/ is rebuilt inside each job — so the artifact handoff is intent rather than a guarantee of the exact published bytes, and a prepare failure in the publish job fails the publish for reasons unrelated to the downloaded artifact.

`--provenance` depends on the `id-token: write` permission granted at both workflow and job level alongside `contents: read`, and `--access public` is required because the published name is scoped (@xiedada/nodemw-mcp-server).

The workflow neither bumps nor validates the version: nothing compares package.json's version to the release, so the maintainer must commit the intended version before creating the release, otherwise npm rejects the upload because that version of the package already exists and the release has no corresponding publish.

依赖检查与 `npm run build` 是发布工作流里仅有的两道关口，而 `npm ci` 自身就会跑 `postinstall`（patch-package）与 `prepare`（构建），所以补丁失败或 esbuild 报错会在安装阶段就中止发布；`npm run lint`、`npm test`、`tsc --noEmit` 都只是本地命令，即使 `npm test` 现在是真实的 `vitest run` 套件也无法拦住一次发布。

Registry authentication uses NODE_AUTH_TOKEN from the NPM_TOKEN secret plus an explicit NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY of https://registry.npmjs.org/ on top of the registry-url that setup-node writes; the repository's checked-in .npmrc routes a different scope (@xiedada05) to GitHub Packages, which does not apply to the published @xiedada name, and its ${NPM_TOKEN} reference means a local npm publish also needs that variable set.

The publish workflow uses floating major-version action tags (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, upload-artifact@v4, download-artifact@v4) rather than full commit SHAs as the OpenWiki workflow does, so a retagged action changes what runs in a job that holds id-token: write and NPM_TOKEN.

Every TypeScript module under src/ opens with the same 27-line BSD-2-Clause header, which is the exact text the build banner emits; scripts/build.js does not carry it as a header (the text lives inside its banner.js string) and the three one-shot codemods scripts/add-annotations.mjs, scripts/add-output-schema.mjs and scripts/convert-tools.mjs do not carry it at all, so the header is a review convention rather than a tooling-enforced rule.

Repository conventions around release are English conventional-commit prefixes (automation itself uses `docs:` for the wiki PR), and generated OpenWiki pages are not hand-edited because a scheduled workflow regenerates them into a PR on the fixed `openwiki/update` branch.

The build has no pre-clean step: a failed esbuild run logs `Build failed:` and exits 1 while any previous dist/index.js remains on disk, so a runnable bundle is not evidence of a successful build and `npm run clean` is the explicit reset.

OpenWiki 更新工作流是仓库里的第二个 CI 工作流，只生成/更新文档而不运行项目自身的构建、测试或 lint；它由 `workflow_dispatch` 与每天 08:00 UTC 的 `cron "0 8 * * *"` 触发，并申请 `contents: write` 与 `pull-requests: write`（为了推分支、开 PR），与发布工作流的 `id-token: write` 是两套完全不同的权限模型。

OpenWiki 工作流的检出使用 `fetch-depth: 0`，因为 `openwiki code --update` 需要把 HEAD 与它上次文档化的提交做 diff，浅克隆会隐藏那个提交并使更新针对空变更摘要运行；该工作流用 Node 22、把 checkout/setup-node/create-pull-request 钉在完整提交 SHA 上，并全局安装 `openwiki@0.7.2` 加可选的 `mermaid@11.16.0`/`jsdom@29.1.1`（只为 Mermaid 图的高保真校验），因此不依赖本项目的 devDependencies 或 bundle 是否可构建。

生成步骤 `openwiki code --update --print`（id `openwiki`）设置 `continue-on-error: true`，通过 `openai-compatible` provider 与模型 `deepseek-flash` 调用外部服务（密钥来自 `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY`，base URL 来自仓库变量 `OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL`），随后在 `if: ${{ !cancelled() }}` 下删除瞬时的 `openwiki/.run.json` 并以同样的条件继续后续步骤，所以失败不会中断流水线。

工作流的产出以 PR 形式收口：`add-paths` 是 `openwiki`、`AGENTS.md` 与工作流文件自身，并在 `CLAUDE.md` 存在时追加它（因为该文件里嵌了 `@AGENTS.md` 的 OPENWIKI 块），路径拼接前先做存在性判断以免 `git add` 因缺失路径整批失败；PR 分支固定为 `openwiki/update`，commit 与标题都是 `docs: update OpenWiki`，body 写入 `OpenWiki result: <outcome>`。
失败语义是「PR 照常创建、run 最终标红」：有 PR URL 时输出 notice 注解，而若 `openwiki` 步骤 outcome 为 `failure`，最后一步执行 `exit 1` 把失败传播出去；因此带半成品的 PR 与红色 run 是正常组合，PR body 明确说明 failure 时只保留失败前已完成的页面。
合并一个半成品 OpenWiki PR 就是把这部分进展作为下一轮定时运行的基线，于是未完成的章节不会被自动重写、错误会沿基线继续传播；手工改过的页面也会被下一轮 `--update` 当作既有内容，所以 openwiki/ 下的页面需要谨慎人工编辑，优先改源码或文档再让 OpenWiki 重新生成。

安装期有两段顺序固定的生命周期脚本：`postinstall: patch-package` 先把 `patches/nodemw+0.26.0.patch` 打到 `node_modules/nodemw`，`prepare: npm run build` 再产出 bundle；因此 `npm ci` 一旦 postinstall 失败就以非零码中止、构建不会发生，而 `npm ci --ignore-scripts` 会同时跳过打补丁与重建。补丁文件名编码了精确版本 0.26.0（lockfile 也钉在 0.26.0、并在根条目标出 hasInstallScript），解析到其他版本时 patch-package 匹配失败，把一次静默的小版本升级变成显式的安装失败。

补丁层只属于“从源码安装的部署”，不属于发布产物：`files: ["dist"]` 不含 `patches/`，`patch-package` 也只是 `devDependencies`，所以下载安装 `@xiedada/nodemw-mcp-server` 的下游既拿不到补丁也拿不到执行它的可执行文件；而随包发布的 `package.json` 仍带着 `postinstall: patch-package`，下游安装该依赖包时 npm 会执行这个脚本并很可能以非零码失败。发布工作流不做“从 tarball 安装一次”的冒烟，所以这条风险在发布前不会暴露。

external 名单、patch-package 的补丁目标与 `createRequire()` 的运行时读取必须始终指向同一个 `nodemw`：external 让 bundle 只保留 `import Bot from "nodemw"` 并由使用方的 node_modules 提供实现，这才使补丁（安装期改 node_modules 里的第三方文件）与产物保持分离，也才使 `require('nodemw/package.json')` 能在运行时解析；若把 nodemw 从 external 删掉，esbuild 会内联当时已打补丁的源码，边界消失且外部 package.json 的读取会开始失败。

lockfile 里绝大多数 `resolved` 指向 `registry.npmmirror.com`（约 293 条，registry.npmjs.org 只有 141 条），而 `npm ci` 按 lockfile 记录的地址取包，因此发布工作流的依赖下载依赖该镜像的可用性；工作流里的 `NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY: https://registry.npmjs.org/` 只影响 publish 的目标 registry，不会改写这些下载地址。

`scripts/` 里只有 `build.js` 参与流水线，另外三个 `.mjs` 是一次性 codemod：`add-output-schema.mjs` 按工具名批量写入 outputSchema、`add-annotations.mjs` 补 idempotentHint/openWorldHint、`convert-tools.mjs` 从固定 outputSchemas 表重写工具文件。它们不由任何 npm 脚本调用、也不在 CI 中执行，内部正则与工具名白名单只对当时的源码形态成立，重跑会按过期假设改写当前源码。

eslint.config.js 是 flat config：先忽略 dist/ 与 node_modules/，再对 src/**/*.ts 套用 @typescript-eslint recommended，并把 no-explicit-any 与 no-unused-vars（忽略 `_` 前缀参数）降为 warn，因此 `npm run lint` 很少以非零码结束，也不被任何工作流调用；另外 `eslint src/**/*.ts` 的 glob 由 shell 展开，在常见 sh 下约等于 `src/*/*.ts`，`src/index.ts` 与 `src/tools/ro|editing/` 下的文件可能不在检查范围内。

`npm test` 是 `vitest run`（一次性运行，裸 `vitest` 会进入 watch 并阻塞），测试位于 `src/common/__tests__` 与 `src/tools/__tests__`，工具级测试用 `vi.mock` 替换 `nodemwBot.js` 并用 `InMemoryTransport` 走真实 MCP 协议；这些文件从 `src/index.ts` 不可达，所以从不进入 bundle，也不在发布工作流中运行。

`test-server.js` 是手写的冒烟脚本，没有接进任何 npm 脚本：它唯一的硬断言是 `dist/index.js` 存在（不存在则退出 1），随后 spawn 该产物、注入一个没有任何代码读取的 `CONFIG` 环境变量、截断打印 stdout/stderr，并在 2 秒后 kill —— 无论子进程退出码是什么都打印 `✓ Server test completed`，所以它只能当观察，不能当通过/失败判据。
